records.title: output: reword three masked banned-vocabulary guidance strings
records.release_claim: static guidance uses conservative demonstration language rather than vocabulary that sounds like runtime proof
records.reason: The #2119 extraction exposed three strings previously hidden by a whole-file allowlist. Rewording removes the fine-grained debt without changing classifications, schemas, or goldens.
records.non_claim: The word change does not strengthen the analyzer evidence or claim that a repair route is runtime confirmed.

records.title: test(output): harden doctor timeout fixture materialization
records.release_claim: doctor timeout proof uses a hermetic executable fixture and preserves timeout evidence precision across supported Unix environments
records.reason: The prior hanging-tool fixture could race scheduler or shell differences and turn a correct candidate red; this hardens exact-candidate proof rather than changing normal doctor semantics.
records.non_claim: Test-fixture robustness does not alter the default runtime probe deadline or promote preview support.

records.title: test(output): name transient doctor tool launch failures distinctly
records.release_claim: doctor distinguishes a genuinely missing runtime from a transient process-launch failure and retries only the transient class in the stress fixture
records.reason: Collapsing every launch error into 'not available' produces false environment evidence. Carrying ErrorKind preserves the user-visible distinction and keeps timeout results from being retried away.
records.non_claim: A transient launch failure does not prove the tool exists or that a later verification command would pass.

records.title: test(output): add brief backoff between doctor launch retries
records.release_claim: the doctor stress fixture gives transient process-table pressure time to clear without masking a real timeout or exceeding the bounded test deadline
records.reason: This is the final flake control in the #2242 sequence and affects qualification reliability rather than product behavior.
records.non_claim: Normal doctor execution does not gain hidden retries or a changed timeout contract.
